Req ID: 142513

Remote Position: Hybrid

Region: Americas

Country: Canada

State/Province: Ontario

City: Toronto

16 Month Internship

As a global technology leader, Celestica designs, engineers, and manufactures industry-leading products and services that drive customer success and market advancement. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, we bring together over 33,000 employees across more than 45 sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. Working with the world’s leading technology companies across a broad range of industries, Celestica helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage. These products span key areas such as data centre technology, aerospace and defense, healthtech, and capital equipment.

Working at Celestica is more than a job. It’s about being part of something bigger and shaping the future with your work. You’ll take on exciting and challenging projects, get hands-on experience, collaborate with a global team, and learn from some of the greatest minds in the industry. And just as we aspire to imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers, we’re just as committed to delivering the best employee experience.

Benefits For Students Include



- Experience working for one of the largest Canadian global technology companies 
- Possibility of a student casual contract position after completion of internship 
- Possibility of a full-time position after completion of degree 
- Access to Celestica’s development programs and projects 
- Celestica's Time Off to Volunteer program – two paid days off to volunteer per year 
- Fun intern activities including celebration events and networking 
- Internal recognition programs and rewards for stellar performance 

What’s in it for you?



- Opportunity: Job experience at a large Canadian-based global company 
- Innovation: We look to our employees to implement new ideas and improve the way we do things 
- Collaboration: Students work as part of global teams, enabled by collaborative technology 
- Sustainability: We uphold strong ethics, reduce our impact on the environment and empower employees to give back to the community with two paid days off per year to volunteer 
- Development opportunities: including soft skills courses, innovation projects and mentorship 
- Networking: Strategically build your professional network to advance your career and deepen relationships across your peers and colleagues. 
- Fun: Our interns have the opportunity to participate in fun activities including intern social events, Celestica’s charitable initiatives and our Spirit Week activities 

About This Opportunity

Students who excel in this position enjoy creating, maintaining, and improving tools and processes that empower global Engineering teams (Hardware, Software, Test, and Solution Design) and drive operational efficiency across our business.

This role supports our ATS Team, where the Engineering AI Intern will be responsible for operating, maintaining, and developing various AI tools (eg. AI agents & AI automation) and workflows. Working across a variety of projects alongside domain experts, the Intern will design and integrate AI-powered solutions—including project management tools, smart automation for repetitive tasks, and AI evaluation tools—to speed up project delivery for project managers and engineers. These efforts support essential functions such as Engineering Design Validation, Automated Test Execution, Pipeline Optimization, and Technical Documentation. This is a role in supporting the Engineering Leadership team in delivering predictable and flawless execution of programs, projects, and initiatives.

The Intern will enjoy a stimulating and challenging work environment within a highly motivated team. We are looking for a self-motivated, independent problem solver who learns quickly and communicates effectively. The candidate should be comfortable working with modern software development environments (such as VS Code), web development technologies, and cloud platforms—particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP)—alongside strong programming fundamentals.

Preferred Skills



- Strong Knowledge of programming (Javascript or Python preferred) and web development fundamentals 
- Hands-on experience or familiarity with Agentic AI workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP), alongside a broad understanding of contemporary artificial intelligence and machine learning models is an asset, but not required. 
- Experience with cloud hosting and computing platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Microsoft Azure (GCP preferred) is an asset, but not required. 
- Experience developing custom Google App Scripts is an asset, but not required. 
- Excellent analytical, technical, troubleshooting and problem solving skills 
- Strong understanding of office and productivity suites, such as Google Workspace and LibreOffice 
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with domain experts and stakeholders 
- Strong self-motivation, initiative, and ability to work independently 
- Strong project documentation habits and experience creating clear technical and user documentation 

Activities



- Collaborate with domain experts, Project Managers, and Engineers across the ATS Team to gather requirements, identify workflow bottlenecks, and scope AI integration opportunities. 
- Design, build, and integrate AI-powered tools, web applications, and agentic workflows (including MCP-based integrations) that automate routine tasks and speed up day-to-day workflows for engineering and project teams. 
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve internal tools and reporting solutions 
- Deploy, administer, and maintain applications and services on cloud platforms (primarily Google Cloud Platform) to ensure reliability and scalability. 
- Create and maintain comprehensive project, technical, and process documentation across Google Workspace and LibreOffice. 
-  Provide demonstrations, onboarding, and system training to end users to drive adoption of new AI tools and workflows. 
- Work closely with cross-functional Engineering, IT, and Leadership teams to deliver solutions that support predictable program and project execution. 

Physical Demands, duties of this position are varied and will include:



- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. 
- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. 
- Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required. 

Salary

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

The hourly wage is determined by the years of study completed and is non-negotiable as per company policy.

Hourly Wage: $23-30 CAD/hr

Additional Details

Area: Global Engineering & Product Development

Start Date: May 2027

Location: 5140 Yonge St, Toronto, ON

Vacancies: 1 position

Experience: No formal experience is required

Education: Enrollment in a University Internship/Co-op program, completing 3rd year of an Engineering, IT, or Computer Science Program.

To apply, please visit www.celestica.com. Please provide a copy of your transcript with your application. Please include your student email address in your application.

Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).

At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.

Company Overview

Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.

Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):

ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.

CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth.

Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.

Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

jd:
Description

Chez Tecsys, les logiciels que nous livrons permettent aux hôpitaux, aux pharmacies et aux distributeurs d'obtenir ce dont ils ont besoin, au moment où ils en ont besoin. Chaque rôle ici contribue à ce résultat.

Pourquoi ce rôle est important

En tant que stagiaire développeur, vous vous joindrez à l'équipe responsable de notre plateforme interne d'automatisation des tests, une équipe au cœur de la façon dont Tecsys détecte les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les clients. Vous développerez des fonctionnalités dans l'interface React et les services Python de la plateforme, vous rédigerez et maintiendrez des tests automatisés, et vous contribuerez au bon fonctionnement des pipelines CI/CD à chaque merge request. Votre travail aide nos développeurs à livrer en toute confiance, afin que les logiciels sur lesquels les hôpitaux et les distributeurs comptent continuent de fonctionner.

Ce dont vous ferez partie

Tecsys est un partenaire de confiance d'organisations essentielles des secteurs de la santé et de la distribution, pour qui nous alimentons des chaînes d'approvisionnement résilientes, efficaces et sécuritaires. Nous sommes un fournisseur mondial de logiciels infonuagiques propulsés par l'IA, coté à la Bourse de Toronto (TSX : TCS).

Trois valeurs guident notre façon de travailler. Nous gagnons la confiance chaque jour en valorisant le client et en agissant avec intégrité. Nous nous tirons mutuellement vers le haut en reconnaissant les forces de chacun et en travaillant comme une seule équipe. Et nous explorons avec audace en restant curieux et en nous adaptant pour réussir.

Vous vous joindrez à une culture animée par la curiosité, l'apprentissage continu et des gens qui repoussent les limites du possible.

Ce que vous ferez



- Développer et améliorer des fonctionnalités de notre plateforme interne d'automatisation des tests, tant dans l'interface React que dans les services backend et les API Python (Flask/FastAPI)
- Corriger des bogues et remanier le code existant, en rédigeant des tests unitaires pytest en parallèle de vos modifications
- Contribuer aux fonctionnalités de rapports de résultats de tests, comme les tableaux de bord, les tendances et les comparaisons d'une exécution à l'autre
- Utiliser des assistants de programmation propulsés par l'IA (Claude Code, Kiro) dans votre développement quotidien, en révisant et en testant ce qu'ils produisent
- Effectuer des premières révisions de code sur les merge requests et maintenir les pipelines CI/CD afin que les tests automatisés s'exécutent à chaque merge request
- Créer et maintenir des tests de régression automatisés d'API, d'interface utilisateur et unitaires, y compris transformer des enregistrements Playwright en tests d'interface stables et maintenables
- Investiguer les échecs, signaler les défauts en indiquant clairement les étapes de reproduction, et documenter les fonctionnalités, la couverture de tests et la façon d'exécuter les suites de tests


Requirements

Exigences

Ce que vous apportez

Vous n'avez pas besoin de correspondre à chacune des lignes ci-dessous. Si la plupart vous décrivent, postulez :



- Être à la dernière année d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe
- Être disponible pour un stage d'au moins deux sessions
- Bonne connaissance de Python et de React, et capacité à lire et à comprendre du code existant
- Expérience avec Git et les flux de travail de merge/pull requests
- Utilisation concrète d'un assistant de programmation IA tel que Claude Code, Kiro ou Copilot
- Souci du détail et bonne communication écrite
- Des stages coop antérieurs dans d'autres entreprises sont un atout

Nous favorisons un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé, respecté et en mesure de s'épanouir.

Si ce rôle correspond à ce que vous cherchez, postulez dès aujourd'hui. Si vous ne cherchez pas activement, mais que vous souhaitez en savoir plus, nous serons heureux d'en discuter.

Postulez dès aujourd'hui et découvrez tout ce que vous pourriez bâtir, résoudre et accomplir avec Tecsys!
fit_why: Test automation platform: React and Python, but QA-focused, not product

jd:
**Wyvern is making something big**. Our vision is to provide actionable intelligence from space, anywhere in the solar system. To achieve this we need to entirely reimagine how satellite Earth observation is done.

We’re a rapidly growing space company in Western Canada, powered by humans who are passionate about space and are redesigning the satellite to enable a sustainable future for humanity. Wyvern has been through Y Combinator's Winter 2022 batch and has raised >USD$20M in pre-seed, seed, and non-dilutive funding. If you’re excited by the prospect of creating a better earth from space, we want you on our team.

**WHAT WE’RE WORKING ON**
-------------------------

Wyvern is developing unfolding space telescopes to capture high-resolution hyperspectral imagery from space.

Hyperspectral images contain more colors than other types of imagery, meaning these images capture the spectral signature of your crop or forest, for example. With hyperspectral imagery, however, it’s hard to get quality images with a high signal-to-noise ratio and high resolution. To mitigate this, we’re designing optical telescopes that are compact on launch and *deploy in space*, meaning we pack better performance in a smaller, cheaper-to-launch package. Our increased light collecting area will allow for more light in more bands while maintaining <5 m resolution.

Our Data Science Intern will work with our Product team to test the applicability of various imagery datasets for the use in many applications across multiple verticals, including agriculture, energy, and forestry to name a few.

**WHAT WYVERN EXPECTS FROM YOU**
--------------------------------

* You are proficient in Python programming.
* You are familiar with data science libraries/packages such as scikit-learn, pandas, and matplotlib OR familiar with GIS fundamentals and interested in upskilling your software development skills.
* You are involved in extracurricular team projects that challenge your technical skills (ex. hackathons, robotics club, etc.).
* You can explain technical concepts about your work to non-technical people and keep them engaged as you explain.
* You are excited to dig into problems which might not have solutions.
* You are excited about AI and machine learning as it relates to imagery processing and data science.
* You work well independently but know when to ask for support.
* You must be enrolled in an undergraduate program at a Canadian university.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**
--------------------------

* Work with our Product team (remote, or Edmonton).
* Investigate applications of hyperspectral imagery to solve real world problems.
* Uncover trends, key features, and actionable insights within complex datasets.
* Develop machine learning models using data science fundamentals.
* Produce documentation, promotional materials, and tutorials to support the adoption of hyperspectral imaging.
* Gain familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS) and hyperspectral geospatial datasets.

**WHAT TO EXPECT FROM WYVERN**
------------------------------

* While this position is full-time, working hours are flexible. Some travel for team events will be required.
* Wyvern is a small but mighty team, you’ll get the support and mentorship of the entire organization.
* We’re small but rapidly growing; you’ll see what it’s like to work in a startup.
* This is a 4 or 8 month position beginning as soon as late January 2027; the exact start date is TBD.
* Compensation will be around $22-26 CAD/hour depending on qualifications.

Apply via your campus job board or Internship office, or submit an application through our online job posting at **https://wyvern.rippling-ats.com/**
